subject: skill:router
gist: A resumed change is set open; an unrelated request stops it first
reason: The router sets a resumed change open as its first write and stops the change a session holds before routing an unrelated request. The routing map exempts from the record a close that writes only into the knowledge homes.

authorisedBy.words: The operator's cards of 2026-10-14 on part 2 of the-whole-change, each "Rule as proposed": a change is open while a session holds it and stopped when none does, set at every stop with its "next" line, and resuming sets it open; a new request that is not a follow-up stops the open change first; greenline status lists each open and stopped change with its "next" line; and a close asked for by name that writes only into the knowledge homes needs no change record

ruling.words: The method items carry the cutover of the block to the modes (S16a), under the operator's rulings of 2026-10-04, "cool then lock everything in": a start hands the job to a mode the owner approves, every change has one record with its working files and its folder, and a start that edits no file needs no mode and no record
